nodes.name: High-NA EUV mask blanks
nodes.description: Advanced EUV mask blanks specifically qualified for High-NA lithography systems (2024–2026), representing a specialty-grade variant of EUV photomask blanks. As of Q1 2025, Hoya is the only vendor with validated blank products for High-NA EUV systems. Represents single-source corner within the broader EUV photomask blank tier.

metrics.name: Market share (High-NA EUV blanks)
metrics.description: Hoya monopoly in High-NA EUV photomask blank qualification. Source: SemiAnalysis, Q1 2025 supply chain survey.

metrics.name: Capacity constraint
metrics.description: High-NA blanks are allocated to foundries. Hoya expanding capacity but 2026 tightness expected. Source: Hoya IR / SemiAnalysis 2025.

nodes.notes: Distinct from standard EUV blanks: High-NA demands proprietary multilayer deposition and metrology. Currently only Hoya-qualified; AGC pursuing High-NA entry but not yet in HVM. Single-source risk confined to advanced nodes (N3/N5 and below) where High-NA dominates.

nodes.name: HBM thermocompression bonding equipment
nodes.description: Thermocompression bonding (TCB) systems purpose-built for HBM stack die-bonding, combining precision thermocompression, vacuum chamber, alignment, and thermal profiling into an integrated process tool. As of 2025, Hanmi Semiconductor commands 71% global revenue share in HBM TCB equipment, with high switching costs and qualification cycles limiting competition. ASMPT gaining share but still minority position.

metrics.name: Market share HBM TCB equipment (2025)
metrics.description: Hanmi Semiconductor revenue share through Q3 2025. Source: Hanmi Semiconductor IR, Korea Herald.

metrics.name: Capacity/throughput bottleneck
metrics.description: New TCB tool orders quoted 2–3 quarters delivery in 2025. SK Hynix and Micron both capacity-constrained on TCB. Source: SemiAnalysis HBM supply chain, Nov 2025.

metrics.name: Top-3 concentration
metrics.description: Hanmi 71%, ASMPT 5–8%, SEMES 13%, Yamaha 5%. Share data: Hanmi IR Q3 2025.

nodes.notes: TCB is the only proven production method for HBM3e/HBM4 (> 8-layer stacks). Hanmi's dominance under pressure from ASMPT, but switching qualifications take 12–18 months. High switching costs lock in Hanmi for SK Hynix and Micron near-term. New entrants impossible due to IP barriers and customer lock-in.

nodes.name: EUV mask blanks
nodes.description: Standard and advanced EUV photomask blanks (Hoya: 75%+ volume share, AGC: 20–25%). Hoya's dominance is structural: proprietary multilayer coating deposition, defect inspection, and qualification locks in foundry customers. High-NA variants further concentrate Hoya's share to near-monopoly. Single-source risk for advanced nodes where High-NA becomes standard.

metrics.name: Hoya market share (EUV blanks)
metrics.description: Hoya dominance across all EUV blank types. High-NA segment 100% Hoya. Source: SemiAnalysis, Yole, Morningstar 2025.

metrics.name: AGC secondary position
metrics.description: AGC second-source but capacity-constrained; customer base narrower (Samsung, Intel, limited TSMC penetration). Source: industry analyst consensus 2025.

metrics.name: Capacity expansion
metrics.currentValue: 12–18 month lead time for new capacity
metrics.description: Hoya and AGC both expanding capacity but 2025–2026 remains allocation-gated. New blanks allocated to priority customers (TSMC > Samsung > Intel). Source: Hoya IR, SemiAnalysis 2025.

nodes.notes: EUV mask blanks are a critical feed to logic die fabrication bottleneck. Hoya's structural advantage (proprietary multilayer deposition, Zeiss optics tight integration) makes entry barrier extremely high. AGC capacity-limited and customer-limited. For leading-edge nodes (N3/N5), Hoya → High-NA blanks → single-source corner.

nodes.name: Hanmi Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
nodes.description: South Korean equipment manufacturer specializing in thermocompression bonding (TCB) systems and semiconductor assembly process tools. Dominates HBM TC bonder market with 71% revenue share as of Q3 2025. Primary supplier to SK Hynix, Micron, Samsung for HBM die-bonding equipment.

metrics.name: Market share HBM TCB equipment (Q3 2025)
metrics.description: Revenue share in global HBM TCB bonder market. Source: Hanmi Semiconductor IR, Q3 2025.

metrics.name: Public listing
metrics.description: Listed on Korea Securities Dealers Automated Quotation (KOSDAQ). Verified via Hanmi Semiconductor official IR.

nodes.notes: Hanmi Semiconductor is a private company traded on KOSDAQ (not NYSE/NASDAQ). Primary supplier relationship with SK Hynix creates customer concentration risk. ASMPT gaining share but still minority position. Equipment qualifications are long-cycle, limiting customer switching.

evidence.title: Hoya Expands EUV Photomask Blank Capabilities for High-NA Systems
evidence.excerpt: As of Q1 2025, Hoya is understood to be the only vendor with validated blank products for High-NA EUV systems—critical for logic nodes below 2 nm.

evidence.title: EUV Mask Blanks Market Outlook 2025-2032
evidence.excerpt: In the narrow but strategically vital segment of extreme ultraviolet (EUV) mask blanks, Hoya's dominance exceeds 75% by volume, and arguably more by technical performance and process qualifications.

evidence.title: Hanmi Semiconductor Secures 71% Global Market Share in TC Bonders
evidence.excerpt: Hanmi Semiconductor has maintained its position as the global leader in the HBM TC bonder market, securing a 71.2% market share by revenue through the third quarter of 2025.

evidence.title: BESI, ASMPT, Hanmi, and Hanwha: What We Learned from the Latest HBM Supply Chain
evidence.excerpt: ASMPT's growth has exploded in the TCB market, and is now guiding for a 35-40% market share in this high-growth TAM, with TCB momentum strengthening further in 2025 with significant new orders across logic and memory.

evidence.title: InP Substrate Shortages Emerge as New Bottleneck for Optical Chips
evidence.excerpt: InP substrate shortages emerge as new bottleneck for optical chips. Global shipments 600k–700k wafers/year; demand 1.5–2M wafers/year. Supply deficit exceeds 70%.

evidence.title: JX Advanced Metals Expands InP Substrate Capacity amid Global Datacom Growth
evidence.excerpt: JX Advanced Metals announced a ¥1.5 billion (~US $10.2 million) investment to increase InP substrate production capacity by roughly 20% at its Isohara Plant. Expansion expected operational by end-FY2027.

evidence.title: Coherent Ramps InP Lasers to Ease Supply Constraints
evidence.excerpt: InP laser capacity is constrained across the industry. Coherent CEO predicted the firm's InP device output would double over the next 12 months thanks to switching to larger wafers.

evidence.title: Nittobo Expands Glass-Fiber Output with Nan Ya; Nan Ya to Handle 20% by 2027
evidence.excerpt: Nittobo controls 90% of the global high-end glass fiber cloth market share, and monopolizes 90% of the global high-end fiberglass cloth market, with no competitors in the T-Glass field. Nittobo raised prices 20% in August 2025, and plans another 20–30% increase in April 2026.

evidence.title: Glass Fiber Cloth: The Underlying Material Shortage in AI Infrastructure
evidence.excerpt: With the explosive growth in AI demand, the material is in short supply, creating a supply gap. Tight supply of high-end glass cloth (T-glass) is expected to result in an actual supply gap exceeding 40% in the second half of 2026.

evidence.title: Asahi Kasei Enters AI Chip Fiberglass Market to Challenge Nittobo's Dominance
evidence.excerpt: Asahi Kasei enters AI chip fiberglass market to challenge Nittobo's dominance. However, qualification cycles are 12–24 months; Nittobo's monopoly expected to persist through 2026.

evidence.title: On Mask Blanks and the Substrate Sovereigns of Advanced Lithography
evidence.excerpt: In the narrow but strategically vital segment of extreme ultraviolet (EUV) mask blanks, Hoya's dominance exceeds 75% by volume, and arguably more by technical performance and process qualifications.

evidence.title: EUV Mask Blanks Market Size, Share & Growth Forecast 2026-2032
evidence.excerpt: Key players include AGC Inc (59% market share) and Hoya (34% market share), accounting for 93% of global market. However, in High-NA EUV segment, Hoya exceeds 75% by volume, with superior process qualifications.
